title: San Francisco AI Boom Brings Growing Fears of a Market Crash
excerpt: Artificial intelligence workers in San Francisco are expressing concerns that the booming sector may be overheated and heading toward a crash.
body_html:
San Francisco has emerged as the central hub for the artificial intelligence industry, experiencing a significant boom. However, as the sector expands rapidly, workers within the industry are beginning to voice concerns.

According to reports from the area, employees at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom are growing increasingly worried that the market is becoming overheated. These anxieties center around the possibility that the current pace of growth is unsustainable, leading to mounting fears that a sector-wide crash could be on the horizon.
